Thomaspartners Inc. lifted its position in shares of Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 1.0% in the 1st quarter, according to its most recent Form 13F filing with the Securities & Exchange Commission. The institutional investor owned 1,038,011 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after acquiring an additional 10,761 shares during the period. Thomaspartners Inc.’s holdings in Apple were worth $174,157,000 as of its most recent filing with the Securities & Exchange Commission.
Other institutional investors and hedge funds have also recently made changes to their positions in the company. Turim 21 Investimentos Ltda. increased its position in shares of Apple by 5.1% during the first quarter. Turim 21 Investimentos Ltda. now owns 59,421 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $9,970,000 after acquiring an additional 2,906 shares in the last quarter. Shelton Capital Management grew its position in Apple by 2.3% in the 3rd quarter. Shelton Capital Management now owns 437,397 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $67,412,000 after purchasing an additional 9,758 shares during the period. Hikari Power Ltd bought a new stake in Apple in the 3rd quarter worth approximately $208,000. PFG Advisors bought a new stake in Apple in the 4th quarter worth approximately $330,000. Finally, Oakmont Partners LLC grew its position in Apple by 10.6% in the 4th quarter. Oakmont Partners LLC now owns 13,971 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $2,364,000 after purchasing an additional 1,335 shares during the period. 58.07% of the stock is owned by institutional investors. A number of equities research analysts have commented on the stock. Sanford C. Bernstein set a $190.00 target price on shares of Apple and gave the stock a “neutral” rating in a research report on Monday. BidaskClub raised shares of Apple from a “hold” rating to a “buy” rating in a research report on Monday, June 18th. UBS Group set a $210.00 price objective on shares of Apple and gave the company a “buy” rating in a research report on Wednesday, June 13th. Macquarie reissued a “buy” rating and set a $197.00 price objective on shares of Apple in a research report on Monday, June 11th. Finally, Argus boosted their price objective on shares of Apple from $210.00 to $225.00 and gave the company a “buy” rating in a research report on Friday, June 8th. One analyst has rated the stock with a sell rating, sixteen have issued a hold rating, thirty-one have issued a buy rating and two have assigned a strong buy rating to the company. Apple presently has an average rating of “Buy” and a consensus price target of $206.89. In related news, insider Philip W. Schiller sold 69,491 shares of the company’s stock in a transaction dated Tuesday, April 3rd. The shares were sold at an average price of $166.42, for a total transaction of $11,564,692.22. The sale was disclosed in a filing with the SEC, which can be accessed through this hyperlink . Also, SVP Daniel J. Riccio sold 17,375 shares of the company’s stock in a transaction dated Wednesday, April 4th. The shares were sold at an average price of $169.12, for a total transaction of $2,938,460.00. Following the transaction, the senior vice president now owns 66,191 shares in the company, valued at $11,194,221.92. The disclosure for this sale can be found here . Insiders have sold a total of 279,074 shares of company stock worth $49,607,454 over the last quarter. 0.06% of the stock is currently owned by insiders.
Shares of Apple opened at $182.17 on Tuesday, Marketbeat.com reports. The stock has a market cap of $938.29 billion, a P/E ratio of 19.78, a PEG ratio of 1.52 and a beta of 1.29. Apple Inc. has a 12 month low of $142.28 and a 12 month high of $194.20. The company has a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.80, a quick ratio of 1.37 and a current ratio of 1.46.
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last issued its quarterly earnings results on Tuesday, May 1st. The iPhone maker reported $2.73 EPS for the quarter, beating the consensus estimate of $2.69 by $0.04. The company had revenue of $61.14 billion for the quarter, compared to the consensus estimate of $60.94 billion. Apple had a net margin of 21.55% and a return on equity of 39.97%. The firm’s revenue was up 15.6% compared to the same quarter last year. During the same period in the prior year, the firm posted $2.10 EPS. equities analysts forecast that Apple Inc. will post 11.42 EPS for the current year.
Apple declared that its Board of Directors has approved a stock repurchase plan on Tuesday, May 1st that permits the company to buyback $100.00 billion in outstanding shares. This buyback authorization permits the iPhone maker to purchase up to 11.9% of its stock through open market purchases. Stock buyback plans are generally a sign that the company’s management believes its stock is undervalued.
Apple Company Profile
Apple Inc designs, manufactures, and markets mobile communication and media devices, and personal computers to consumers, and small and mid-sized businesses; and education, enterprise, and government customers worldwide. The company also sells related software, services, accessories, networking solutions, and third-party digital content and applications.
